newsitem.title: PERU: Peru defense head also resigns in political crisis.
newsitem.headline: Peru defense head also resigns in political crisis.

text.p: Peru Defence Minister Gen. Tomas Castillo Meza has resigned from President Alberto Fujimori's cabinet due to recent allegations of rights abuses by the security forces, government sources said on Thursday.
Castillo's departure, which could not be immediately confirmed by official government spokesmen, followed Wednesday's resignation of Foreign Minister Francisco Tudela.
Tudela was widely believed to have resigned to dissasociate himself from a string of embarrassing scandals facing Fujimori's government.
The sources said the defence post would be filled by Interior Minister Gen. Cesar Saucedo Sanchez, who in turn would be replaced by regional military head Gen. Jose Villanueva Ruesta.

The cabinet reshuffle came as Fujimori's popularity tumbled to its lowest level in seven years of power on a series of allegations against his government including claims of phone-tapping by secret services and the persecution of an Israeli-born businessman's who was stripped of his local citizenship.
The allegation believed to have brought Meza's departure was the recent torture of army intelligence agent Leonor La Rosa by colleagues angry at her alleged leaks to the media.
